Policy.principle-1: Verification is contract-driven: each module has explicit checks mapped by verification-ref.
Policy.principle-2: Medical safety and access policies are validated server-side before UI assumptions.
Policy.principle-3: Critical reward/payment operations require idempotency and audit evidence.
Policy.principle-4: Each critical data flow emits stable markers with request and actor correlation.

flow.name: OnboardingFlow
flow.must-pass: Bot deep link opens TMA, diagnostic submission persists, +20 MC applied exactly once.
flow.must-fail: Replay diagnostic completion event does not duplicate onboarding reward.

flow.name: EconomyFlow
flow.must-pass: Exercise completion creates accrual transaction and updates balance.
flow.must-fail: Debit that exceeds balance is rejected and logged.

flow.name: MedicalSafetyFlow
flow.must-pass: redFlag=true creates escalation and locks heavy exercises.
flow.must-fail: Attempt to bypass lock from client is denied by API policy.

flow.name: SubscriptionGateFlow
flow.must-fail: Expired users are blocked from heavy level and receive renewal signal.

flow.name: CRMContentFlow
flow.must-pass: Operator upload creates signed media path and content becomes available.
flow.must-fail: Unauthenticated or unauthorized upload attempts are denied.

flow.name: ConversionCampaignFlow
flow.must-pass: Segmented campaign steps are sent in valid finite-step order with server-timed deadline copy and canonical script sequence.
flow.must-fail: Out-of-window steps, invalid transitions, over-cadence sends, and medically suppressed recipients are blocked by policy guard.

flow.name: LocalizationResolutionFlow
flow.must-pass: Locale is resolved in deterministic order and returned content is language-consistent across UI and API payloads.
flow.must-fail: Unsupported locale values gracefully fallback without mixed-language payload fragments.

flow.name: PanicEscalationFlow
flow.must-pass: Panic action triggers immediate escalation event and operator alert.
flow.must-fail: Failure to notify operator or create escalation record is surfaced as critical incident.
